comments.body:
A couple of thoughts/suggestions:

in .angular-cli.json  perhaps something like this would be helpful?

```json
"scripts": [
  "../node_modules/instantsearch.js/dist/instantsearch.js"
 ],
```

https://github.com/angular/angular-cli/wiki/stories-third-party-lib

Does instantsearch.js need typings?

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/39915178/how-does-angular-cli-work-with-es6-modules

is this the direction things need to change to?
[Make an angular module](https://medium.com/@cyrilletuzi/how-to-build-and-publish-an-angular-module-7ad19c0b4464#.fpa550gby)
Thanks for your research. We really want to make this work, so if you find things that work, we'll gladly merge it, but didn't get a good solution yet
Any update on when this will be fixed? I am running into the same issue with AutoComplete.js with Algolia.

@Bengejd Thanks for getting back here, the more feedback we get on Angular, the better because we might give better tooling around Angular in the future.

Right now we need a reproducible way to understand your bug, for example a GIT repository where we can do npm install, npm start and if it fails, try to fix it for you.

I'm using angular 4 and importing looks like working with 

npm install instantsearch.js --save

and in the ts  : 
import * as instantsearch from 'instantsearch.js';

Dunno if it's the problem here
Can you make an example project @foufrix, that would be really helpful ❤️

Here's a working example in Angular 4.3. 

https://gist.github.com/codediodeio/8b8b22844f8fd8a34ff6d6a6e8582468
Thank you very much ! i'll take a look at it !

Hey @darthsitthiander, I assume you saw [the guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/angular-integration.html) we made, since you seem to use similar terminology. 

However, I'm not sure if what you posted in this thread is enough to make it clear what the actual issue is you're facing, can you make a complete example, based on the one we made in the guide, and explain where something goes wrong? Thanks!

P.S.: For anyone visiting this thread, we're currently making a version of InstantSearch, just for Angular, please fill in [this form](https://goo.gl/forms/US09OkyYKByeF1W53) if you want to be contacted when we make a beta version available.
Thanks @darthsitthiander, we'll get back to you

@iam4x Thanks a bunch, it finally works! I was searching for this code for a long time, but obviously not good enough. Just updated the repo as well. I'll be looking into the library once it gets released, thanks! :)
Looks like this bug is sorta fixed. Reopen it if you think I'm wrong :)
